Senses.Explanation: Literally and throughout the sampled corpus, “wherever” or “in every place.” Its Chan value lies chiefly in the predicates whose scope it sets. Linji's record has the fixed line “act as host wherever you are; every place you stand is genuine” (隨處作主，立處皆真). Yuanwu preserves the paired formula “act as host wherever you are; on meeting conditions, they are the source” (隨處作主，遇緣即宗). A teaching-seat address defines the work of a lineage teacher with “wherever he is, he raises the guiding principle; he answers questions according to the occasion” (隨處提綱，應機問答). Other records use the same distributive word in “named wherever [it appears]” (隨處立名), “arise right here and perish wherever” (當處出生，隨處滅盡), and “clear wherever [you are]” (隨處明了). These predicates are distinct; the location word is not. No departure from its ordinary distributive meaning was found, and none is manufactured.
Senses.Note: Keep this constituent distinct from the full fixed entry “act as host wherever you are” (隨處作主), while linking the two entries.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Old Recorded Sayings of Venerable Masters (古尊宿語錄), in Linji Yixuan's record. Linji Yixuan is the exact speaker of 隨處作主立處皆真.

Occurrences.Kwic: 若委悉得。隨處作主。遇緣即宗。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 圓悟佛果禪師語錄: complete-case exact-turn review identifies Yuanwu Keqin as the actor for this occurrence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 夫為宗匠，隨處提綱。應機問答，殺活臨時。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Complete Book of the Five Lamps, volumes 34–120 (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)), Xiangji Yongmin section. Xiangji Yongmin is the exact speaker who says that a lineage teacher raises the guiding principle wherever he is and answers according to the occasion.

Occurrences.Kwic: 此法身者，即是萬化之本，隨處立名。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 聯燈會要: complete-case exact-turn review identifies Dazhu Huihai as the actor for this occurrence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 當處出生，隨處滅盡，是活生受底規模。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄, Baofeng Weizhao's continuing sequence of hall addresses. Baofeng Weizhao is the exact speaker who contrasts being originally unborn and now unextinguished with arising here and being extinguished wherever one goes.

Occurrences.Kwic: 觸目遇緣，隨處明了，何曾昧却？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 列祖提綱錄 explicitly introduces Chan Master Shuzhong Wenyun's New Year's Eve informal address. Shuzhong is the exact speaker who says that through the year the listeners meet conditions before their eyes and understand wherever they are.
